standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.

standard-dialogue.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Can I buy some leather then?

steps.player: Can I buy some leather then?

steps.npc: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.

steps.player: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.

with-one-or-more-hides-in-the-inventory.npc: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.

with-one-or-more-hides-in-the-inventory.text: If one hide in the inventory:

steps.npc: I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?

with-one-or-more-hides-in-the-inventory.text: If more than one hide in the inventory:

steps.npc: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?

with-one-or-more-hides-in-the-inventory.prompt: What would you like to say?

using-any-type-of-leather-on-tanner.npc: Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
